title: LLM Misalignment via Adversarial RLHF Platforms
reasoning: The paper describes a security attack on the RLHF fine-tuning process to cause model misalignment. While its experimental design involves manipulating hate speech categories (including religion), the core focus is on the technical vulnerability and robustness of the alignment pipeline rather than an evaluation or benchmarking of religious theology, moral frameworks, or ethical reasoning.
